messages:
emily: Heads-up — I kicked off a 5% micro-canary for rwd-v3-int4-candidate on the bridge route. Comparing against rwd-v3-fp16 baseline. Posting the proposed gating + autoshelve rules for review.

ross: Nice. What metrics are you watching? latency/quality/cost?

emily: Primary signals:
- quality: concordance (pass@server) and hallucination rate on our longdoc slice; require concordance drop <= 1.5% relative and hallucination delta <= 0.3% absolute.
- latency: p50/p95/p99 should be within baseline + 40/60/80 ms respectively.
- cost: token-cost-per-response must show >= 18% reduction vs fp16 baseline to justify quantized roll.
- stability: no error-rate spike > 0.2% absolute.

kai: How long before an automatic shelve/rollback? single-window or consecutive windows?

emily: Plan: window = 5m. Auto-shelve (immediate fallback to baseline variant) if any of these happen:
- metric crosses threshold for 3 consecutive windows (15m) OR
- single-window catastrophic (concordance drop > 3% OR hallucination +1% absolute)

Also a soft-stop: if variance on concordance > 2x baseline SD over 3 windows, pause promotion and increase sample.

sofia: Do we need any additional smoke tests (safety/eval slices) before canary?

emily: Yes — run the usual post-deploy micro-evals (sanity, safety, longdoc fidelity). I added the eval set id in rollout config. Example rollout snippet we will push to gatebook: 

```json
{
  "variant": "rwd-v3-int4-candidate",
  "route": "bridge",
  "traffic_percent": 5,
  "windows": 5,
  "metrics": {
    "concordance_rel_drop_pct": 1.5,
    "hallucination_abs_pct": 0.3,
    "p99_latency_ms_delta": 80,
    "error_rate_abs_pct": 0.2
  },
  "autoshelve": {
    "consecutive_windows": 3,
    "emergency_thresholds": {"concordance_rel_drop_pct": 3.0, "hallucination_abs_pct": 1.0}
  }
}
```

ross: Looks reasonable. For the cost threshold, do we measure after quantized kernel warmup (KV warm) or raw token exec time?

emily: Cost calc is post-warmup (we exclude coldstart noise). We'll compare steady-state per-token cost from telemetry after 30m of traffic.

kai: I can wire the alert rules in the observability console. Which dashboard panels should fire?

emily: Panels: concordance delta (cohorted by longdoc/short), hallucination rate, p99 latency, error rate, token-cost. Alert: severity=critical for emergency thresholds, warning for 1.5x margin. Include runbook link pointing to /playbooks/onboard-quant-gates.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: variant=rwd-v3-int4-candidate route=bridge traffic=5% started by emily at 1744449999.

sofia: If the canary passes, what's the intended next step? 25% then 100%?

emily: Yes staged promote: 5 -> 25 -> 60 -> 100 with 30m hold at each stage and the same gating rules. At 25% we enable a safety-sink to shadow-backfill samples for manual review.

ross: Any concern about ensemble parity (rerank + main)? We should ensure reranker version matches candidate to avoid skewed concordance.

emily: Good catch. Reranker pinned to rerank-v2. No change for this canary. We'll add a comparison metric for reranker drift.

kai: I'll add an automated rollback play for the deploy-bot: if autoshelve triggers, deploy-bot will cut traffic back to baseline and create a ticket in #incidents with attached snapshot. OK?

emily: Yep. Also add a flag to preserve the exact inference logs (sample ids + tokens) for 1h post-shelve for repro.

sofia: Can you capture expected customer impact (SLA, cost delta) for sales/CS? I'll coordinate comms.

emily: Will do — I'll post a short markdown summary after 1h steady-state. If we hit >20% cost savings and meet quality gates, tentative promote.

ross: One more small item — add a long-context slice where KV-warm is essential. We had prior regressions masked when KV cold.

emily: Added longctx_kv_warm slice to eval set.

deploy-bot: canary-metrics-sample: 10m snapshot: concordance_rel_drop=0.7%, hallucination_abs=0.12%, p99_delta=52ms, token_cost_delta=22%, error_rate=0.05%. No autoshelve triggered. :eyes:

emily: Nice. I'll watch the next 30m and then propose stage-up if signals hold. Thanks all — will follow up with the formal gatebook PR and the runbook link.
